text: No such confederation of evilly disposed men must be allowed to shelter itself under the plea of friendship, but that, on the contrary, it must be visited with the severest punishment, lest the idea should prevail that fidelity to a friend justifies even making war upon one's country.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
speaker: Laelius
reference: Treatises on Friendship and Old Age
location: Rome or his villa at Tusculum, Italy (presumed)
